GenerateLessonPlan:
Your input fields are:
1. `country` (str): Target country for cultural context
2. `language` (str): Language of instruction
3. `subject` (str): The academic subject
4. `topic` (str): Specific topic to teach
5. `grade_level` (str): Target grade level
6. `learner_notes` (str): What this learner has finished and recently got wrong. Aim the plan at it: a misconception slide for a mistake they keep making, less time on what they have shown they know. Never mention it.
Your output fields are:
1. `reasoning` (str): 
2. `plan` (LessonPlan): Structured lesson plan with slide specifications
All interactions will be structured in the following way, with the appropriate values filled in.

Inputs will have the following structure:

[[ ## country ## ]]
{country}

[[ ## language ## ]]
{language}

[[ ## subject ## ]]
{subject}

[[ ## topic ## ]]
{topic}

[[ ## grade_level ## ]]
{grade_level}

[[ ## learner_notes ## ]]
{learner_notes}

Outputs will be a JSON object with the following fields.

{
  "reasoning": "{reasoning}",
  "plan": "{plan}        # note: the value you produce must adhere to the JSON schema: {\"type\": \"object\", \"$defs\": {\"SlideSpec\": {\"type\": \"object\", \"properties\": {\"keyConcept\": {\"type\": \"string\", \"description\": \"Key concept to cover\", \"title\": \"Keyconcept\"}, \"slideType\": {\"type\": \"string\", \"description\": \"Pedagogical type\", \"enum\": [\"concept_introduction\", \"worked_example\", \"scaffolded_problem\", \"misconception\", \"synthesis\"], \"title\": \"Slidetype\"}, \"title\": {\"type\": \"string\", \"description\": \"Slide title\", \"title\": \"Title\"}}, \"required\": [\"slideType\", \"title\", \"keyConcept\"], \"title\": \"SlideSpec\"}}, \"properties\": {\"keyPoints\": {\"type\": \"array\", \"description\": \"3-5 key takeaways\", \"items\": {\"type\": \"string\"}, \"title\": \"Keypoints\"}, \"learningObjectives\": {\"type\": \"array\", \"description\": \"Measurable objectives\", \"items\": {\"type\": \"string\"}, \"maxItems\": 5, \"minItems\": 3, \"title\": \"Learningobjectives\"}, \"slideSpecs\": {\"type\": \"array\", \"description\": \"Sequence of slides\", \"items\": {\"$ref\": \"#/$defs/SlideSpec\"}, \"maxItems\": 6, \"minItems\": 3, \"title\": \"Slidespecs\"}}, \"required\": [\"learningObjectives\", \"keyPoints\", \"slideSpecs\"], \"title\": \"LessonPlan\"}"
}
In adhering to this structure, your objective is: 
        Create a pedagogical lesson plan.
        Break down the topic into a logical specific sequence of 3-6 slides.
        Ensure a mix of concept, example, and practice slides.
GenerateSlide:
Your input fields are:
1. `subject` (str): The academic subject
2. `topic` (str): Specific topic
3. `grade_level` (str): Target grade level
4. `country` (str): Target country for cultural context
5. `language` (str): Language of instruction. Write every field in it.
6. `previous_context` (str): Summary of what previous slides taught
7. `slide_spec` (SlideSpec): Specification for the slide to write
Your output fields are:
1. `reasoning` (str): 
2. `title` (str): A concise slide title
3. `body_md` (str): The slide in Markdown
4. `question` (str): A question checking what the slide taught
5. `options` (str): Exactly four answer options, one per line, each starting with '- '
6. `answer_index` (int): Zero-based position of the correct option
7. `correct_feedback` (str): Encouraging feedback explaining why the answer is right
8. `incorrect_feedback` (str): Constructive feedback explaining the likely mistake
All interactions will be structured in the following way, with the appropriate values filled in.

Inputs will have the following structure:

[[ ## subject ## ]]
{subject}

[[ ## topic ## ]]
{topic}

[[ ## grade_level ## ]]
{grade_level}

[[ ## country ## ]]
{country}

[[ ## language ## ]]
{language}

[[ ## previous_context ## ]]
{previous_context}

[[ ## slide_spec ## ]]
{slide_spec}

Outputs will be a JSON object with the following fields.

{
  "reasoning": "{reasoning}",
  "title": "{title}",
  "body_md": "{body_md}",
  "question": "{question}",
  "options": "{options}",
  "answer_index": "{answer_index}        # note: the value you produce must be a single int value",
  "correct_feedback": "{correct_feedback}",
  "incorrect_feedback": "{incorrect_feedback}"
}
In adhering to this structure, your objective is: 
        Write one lesson slide following `slide_spec`, and a multiple-choice check on it.
        
        Write every field in `language`, at `grade_level`, with examples from
        `country`. Build on `previous_context` without repeating it.
        
        Mathematics is standard LaTeX: inline between \( and \), as \(\frac{1}{2}\),
        and a standout equation on a line of its own between \[ and \]. Chemistry
        uses \ce{} inside those, as \(\ce{H2O}\). Never use dollar signs for maths:
        they mean money. Use only commands KaTeX renders: write a ceiling as
        \lceil x \rceil. Letters, words and speech sounds are text, never maths: write
        the alphabet as "A, B, C", and sounds with Unicode IPA such as /æ/ or /ʃ/.
        No diagrams or TikZ.
